patterns.note: Content is consistently contained within a max-width, horizontally centered container, with full-width sections often alternating between white and a very light gray background.
Headings are large, bold, sans-serif, and frequently feature a single word or phrase highlighted in the primary accent blue, creating strong visual emphasis.
A high-contrast palette of white, light gray, and a vibrant blue accent is used, with secondary colors (green, orange, red) reserved for subtle code syntax highlighting or small labels.

Sections and content blocks fade in and slide up from the bottom as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic reveal effect. The main navigation bar sticks to the top after initial scroll, and a large, semi-transparent brand name in the footer reveals itself as a background element as the user scrolls to the bottom.
Feature sections frequently combine descriptive text with integrated code snippets and technical diagrams, presented in a clean, readable format.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered animations (likely using locomotive-scroll) to reveal content blocks with a staggered fade-up and subtle slide-in effect as they enter the user's viewport. The main navigation bar transitions to a fixed position at the top of the screen after a short scroll. A large, semi-transparent brand logo in the footer is fixed in the background, becoming visible as the page content scrolls over it.
Code snippets are presented within dedicated, subtly styled blocks, using distinct colors for syntax highlighting to improve readability and visual appeal.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (approx. 3-4x body text size) with key terms highlighted in blue, paired with a clean, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons and some card elements, maintaining a modern, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy and spacious, particularly in hero and main content blocks, providing excellent readability, while feature grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive integration of technical code snippets and diagrams directly into the marketing narrative makes complex information digestible and visually appealing. The subtle, yet effective, scroll-triggered animations and the unique revealing footer text also contribute to a polished, modern feel that elevates it beyond a generic template.
